findings.title: T-11 cites TC-23, which needs the hook firing that T-14 adds in a later epic
quotes: `fire` and `extensions.after(root, slug, n, old_state)` called at the end of `flow.done`, `next_step`, `epic_done` and `implement.finish`, outside the lock" (T-14)
`passed.log` is exactly `x.tests.jury\n` (nothing when the step moved to judging)" (TC-23)
findings.fix: move the `passed.log` assertion of TC-23 to T-14's `Test:`, or move the `fire` wiring from T-14 into T-11.

sources.situation: E-4 (T-11, T-12) closes before E-5 (T-14 hook firing). When the flow runs E-4's tests at its end, TC-23's second half cannot pass: the `step-passed` hook from `y` never fires, so `passed.log` is never written and the assertion that it equals `x.tests.jury\n` fails. Either E-4 can't close, or the worker must add hook firing from T-14's Files, which T-11 does not name (T-11 Files: `src/nio/jury.py`, `tests/test_jury.py`, `tests/test_extensions.py`).

findings.title: T-15 says "fix any gap found" but names no file that holds the timeout code
quotes: Verifies the check timeout (T-7), the hook timeout (T-14) and the manifest timeout rule (T-1) together, with no leftover process; fix any gap found." (T-15)
findings.fix: add `src/nio/implement.py` to T-15's Files, or state that any gap fix stays in `extensions.py` and `flow.py`.

sources.situation: both the check and the hook run through `implement.run(root, command, timeout, env)`, and T-7 lists `src/nio/implement.py` as the file that changes. If TC-47's `sleep 5` run finds a process left alive or a late kill, the fix goes in `implement.py`, which T-15 doesn't list. A worker that follows "Files" leaves the gap open, and one that edits `implement.py` breaks the rule that a task names every file it changes.

sources.situation: T-17 changes `implement.epic_tests` to join one Playwright command, with `-g` escaping, to the other commands, and `evidence.collect` to run each e2e test alone. T-19's check has seven outcome classes, including the setup-error split. Those are more than a "low" effort's worth of subtle logic. The rating is a judgement and doesn't block the work; it may make the worker take too little care with the quoting and the setup-error split.

sources.situation: TC-34 lives in `tests/test_extensions_e2e.py` and needs Node, Chromium and the `e2e-app` fixture from T-20. A normal epic run that doesn't set `NIO_E2E=1` skips it, so E-6 could close with TC-34 never run, or stall on a missing Node install.
